_source: SaveTheCat.com podcast and structural analyses: savethecat.com (Whiplash), studiobinder.com, sellingyourscreenplay.com. Screenplay available at: https://imsdb.com/scripts/Whiplash.html
_notes: 108-page Damien Chazelle draft. Beat positions from multiple cross-referenced STC analyses. Whiplash has an atypical STC structure because the protagonist and antagonist relationship inverts the classic hero/villain dynamic.
title: Whiplash

beat_descriptions.Opening Image: Andrew alone, drumming in an empty practice room late at night.
beat_descriptions.Catalyst: Fletcher enters, hears Andrew play, tests him — and leaves. Andrew is desperate to impress him.
beat_descriptions.Break Into Two: Andrew is invited into Fletcher studio band. He crosses into the upside-down world of Fletcher's rehearsals.
beat_descriptions.Midpoint: Andrew performs successfully at the JVC festival — false victory. Fletcher raises the stakes by promoting another drummer.
beat_descriptions.All Is Lost: Andrew crashes his car racing to the Dunnellen competition, arrives bloodied, plays terribly, attacks Fletcher. Expelled.
beat_descriptions.Break Into Three: Andrew quits music. His father accepts this. Then: a chance at the Carnegie Hall concert.
beat_descriptions.Final Image: Andrew's explosive, transcendent drum solo. Fletcher and Andrew locked in a wordless understanding.
